1.explanation:
• Button/Button.mdx contains the core API and example usage of our Button component and demonstrates how variants (primary, secondary, danger, etc.) are implemented.  
• Button/button-avt.md holds our accessibility validation tests for Button and will show the existing a11y patterns we need to extend for the danger variant.  
• DangerButton/DangerButton.mdx details our dedicated DangerButton wrapper and any special props or patterns it applies to highlight cautionary actions.  
• OverflowMenu/OverflowMenu.mdx defines how menu options render under the hood (including the ‘overflow-menu-options__btn’ class) and is where we need to incorporate aria-describedby so that destructive actions inside menus announce their danger state.
